_comment: Trimmed 8-prompt sample. A real set is 25-40. Frozen for the engagement — see SKILL.md.
buyer_situations: Ops lead at a 30-60 person agency who just lost the one person who understood the spreadsheet.
Founder of a 3-person studio evaluating whether tooling this heavy is premature.
IT manager replacing a tool that was just acquired and repriced.

prompts.text: is example worth it for a three person team
prompts.evidence: 6 r/smallbusiness threads in 5 months, near-identical phrasing; 2 G2 reviews open this way
prompts.note: nobody has written this page. neither has Acme.

prompts.text: example vs acme suite for a 40 person agency
prompts.evidence: named in 4 lost-deal notes provided by client sales
prompts.note: acme owns this today via their own comparison page

prompts.text: how do i stop my team doing the same task twice
prompts.evidence: recurring phrasing across r/agency, r/smallbusiness; nothing authoritative answers it
prompts.note: top of funnel. compounds. currently answered by generic listicles.

prompts.text: best workflow tools for creative agencies 2026
prompts.evidence: high-volume category prompt; every competitor targets it

prompts.text: does example have a free tier
prompts.evidence: support ticket export: 31 tickets in 6 months
prompts.note: answer is on the pricing page but not as a sentence. hallucination risk.

prompts.text: how do i bulk import customers into example
prompts.note: churn surface, not marketing. docs invisible to engines.

prompts.text: is example overkill for a solo freelancer
prompts.evidence: phrasing lifted verbatim from 3 Reddit titles
prompts.note: honest answer is 'probably yes' — say so. builds the trust that wins p001.

prompts.evidence: product sunset Nov 2024; nothing on-site says so
prompts.note: models still describe Lite as available. see hallucination-watch.

cut.why: keyword, not a prompt. no situation in it.
false premise — not a CRM. answering it validates the conflation.
fortified + we don't have the authority to claim it. legal reviews this or we skip it.
winnability 1. the honest answer lists competitors; writing it helps them.
